title: Viral Recent and History show real runs only, and Send to Edit lands in Takes
gap: Each estimate creates a 'quoted' row, and the list returns every row capped at 25 (lib/higgsfield-consumer/jobs.ts:401-405, genjutsu-service.ts:417). Recent and History fill with 'quoted' rows, raw status strings are printed (ViralView.tsx:168), and real results get pushed out of the window. 'Send to Edit' opens studio 'edit' (ViralView.tsx:194), but the take editor that reads selId is on 'takes' (EditStage.tsx:67). The library is not refreshed when a job completes.
target: The list excludes status='quoted' and pages by cursor. Statuses map to readable labels (Queued / Rendering / Checking / Failed · not billed / Done). Send to Edit calls goSuite('studio','takes'). Call refreshProjectLibrary on completion. Resume polling accepted jobs on mount.
respects_rules: Quoted rows stay in the database and are only left out of the list, so nothing is deleted.
